title: ICS 213 from IMT Operations: Depopulation Plan and Support Requests

fields.incidentName: Calder County HPAI — IP-1 Ridgeline Farm

to.name: Alina Petrova
to.position: Deputy Director / Operations, Calder County EOC

from.name: Dana Kowalczyk
from.position: Operations Section Chief, State IMT, IP-1

fields.subject: Depopulation planning: method, crews, support requests
fields.message:
1. METHOD: The IMT is choosing between water-based foam and CO2 for barns 1–4. Foam needs about 2,000 gal of water per barn and our one foam unit. CO2 is slower for toms at this weight, and it depends on a CO2 delivery that is not confirmed before 15:00. Decision by 11:00.
2. CREWS: 46 people are on site or inbound (2 depop teams, 1 carcass-handling team). With the 10-hour shift cap, the first shift ends at 20:30. Second-shift crews arrive from out of state at 22:00. Current projection: barns 3 and 1 done by the end of the first shift. Barns 2 and 4 run on the second shift and finish about 2 hours past the 24-hour goal of 07:50 Wed 10/21.
3. REQUEST: Can the county provide 40 motel rooms tonight and the 18:30 meal for 46? We also need a symptom check point at the staging gate before anyone enters.
Please reply before the 11:00 method decision.

approvedBy.name: Dana Kowalczyk
approvedBy.position: Operations Section Chief, State IMT, IP-1

instructorNote: This form tests whether Ops commits county resources and leaves the depopulation method to the IMT. Ops should confirm the 40-room Larkin motel block, the 18:30 church meal, and the 4,000-gallon Larkin Fire District tanker with hydrant refills for foam water. Public Health should set up PPE and symptom checks at the fairgrounds gate. Watch whether the Director reports the projected 2-hour slip to the Board and state EOC now, or pushes crews past the 10-hour cap.
